periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, approximately 45-60 degrees downward tilt toward the rostrum relative to the facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid with a high height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering reaching toward the muzzle, creating a teardrop morphology.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape across the posterior margin with a relatively flat transverse profile.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick, covering roughly 30-35% of the visible dorsal-to-caudal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement with a distinct inter-pinna gap roughly 2.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Symmetric, smooth convex curvature at the superior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse brownish-orange discoloration/staining present on the white fur of the dorsal nuchal and posterior cranial regions.
